mapper.sql: so.id, sod.id as detailId, so.approve_status as approveStatus, so.code, so.source_code as sourceCode, so.bill_date as billDate, so.approve_status as approveStatus, so.invalid_status as invalidStatus, sod.arrival_status as arrivalStatus, sod.sku_id as skuId, sod.sku_no as skuNo, sod.bom_version as bomVersion, sod.is_urgent as isUrgent, sod.qty, sod.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, so.approve_user_name as approveUserName, so.approve_time as approveTime, so.purchaser_name as purchaserName, so.create_time as createTime, so.create_user_name as createUserName
mapper.select:
select so.id as sourceId, so.code as sourceCode, sod.id as sourceDetailId, sod.sku_id as skuId, sod.sku_no as skuNo, sod.variant_property as variantProperty, so.purchase_org_id as purchaseOrgId, so.purchase_org_name as purchaseOrgName, sod.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sod.warehouse_name as warehouseName, sod.qty, sod.price, sod.amount, sod.is_gift, sod.parent_id as parentId, sod.supplier_id as supplierId, s.name as supplierName, sod.is_generate_po as isGeneratePo, sod.payment_condition as paymentCondition, sod.plan_delivery_date as planDeliveryDate, sod.bom_version as bomVersion from subcontract_order so inner join subcontract_order_detail sod on so.id = sod.main_id and sod.is_deleted = false left join supplier s on sod.supplier_id = s.id and s.is_deleted = false
so.is_deleted = false and so.invalid_status = false
and so.id in
#{item}
order by so.id desc,case sod.parent_id when '' then 1 else 2 end asc

select pod.id from subcontract_order_detail sod inner join purchase_order_detail pod on sod.id = pod.source_detail_id and pod.is_deleted = false inner join purchase_order po on pod.purchase_order_id = po.id and po.is_deleted = false
sod.is_deleted = false and po.invalid_status = false
and sod.id in
#{item}

select distinct so.code from subcontract_order so INNER JOIN subcontract_order_detail sod ON so.id=sod.main_id AND so.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE sod.is_deleted=FALSE and parent_id='' and sod.sku_id=#{bomSkuId}
